summary: Reality Pump and TopWare's open-world fantasy RPG series, including the original Epic Edition, Two Worlds II, its tower-defense spin-off, and later standalone HD expansion releases.

entries.title: Two Worlds
entries.definitive_edition: Two Worlds: Epic Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than Xbox 360 emulation/capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with Epic Edition content.

primary.why: Windows has the best fidelity/capture flexibility, and Epic Edition packages the original game with its Tainted Blood and Curse of Souls expansion content.
primary.how_to_play: Play Two Worlds: Epic Edition on Windows through Steam/GOG/ZOOM or another current PC storefront, applying compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Epic Edition packages the original with the two expansions; no separate remaster with exclusive story content is documented.

entries.title: Two Worlds II
entries.definitive_edition: Two Worlds II HD / Windows release with available story DLC

emulation.notes: Use native PC rather than seventh-generation console versions.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with HD update and DLC.

primary.version: Two Worlds II HD / Windows release with available story DLC
primary.why: Windows is the best fidelity/capture route and has access to the HD engine update and later story DLC content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release with the HD update and available story DLC installed; consider DRM/storefront and compatibility options as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later story DLC/standalone releases complicate the package; verify the desired DLC is installed before treating the base install as complete.

entries.title: Two Worlds II Castle Defense

primary.why: Windows is the best capture route for the standalone Two Worlds tower-defense spin-off, with no Mac-exclusive content documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release through Steam or another current PC storefront.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or exclusive-content edition is documented.

entries.title: Two Worlds II HD: Call of the Tenebrae

primary.why: The standalone release is documented for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with Windows offering the best capture/display control.
primary.how_to_play: Play the standalone Windows release or the equivalent Two Worlds II DLC route; apply compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is also available as DLC for Two Worlds II; the standalone route is useful for cataloging because it does not require the base game.

entries.title: Two Worlds II HD: Shattered Embrace

primary.why: Shattered Embrace is a Windows PC standalone/DLC release, making Windows the complete and best capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the standalone Windows release or the equivalent Two Worlds II DLC route through Steam, using current PC compatibility notes if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Also associated with Two Worlds II as DLC; cataloged separately because storefront/source listings describe a standalone package.
